lines.en: The shield behind my neck blocks the wind.
I walk on four legs, belly brushing the grass.
I am far smaller than my famous kin.
A line of prints follows me on the sand.
I walk along a stand of low bushes.
Head down, I search as I walk.

lines.zh: 我短腿挪着，肚子擦过草尖。
lines.en: My short legs shuffle, belly brushing the grass tips.

lines.zh: 风一吹，沙子就打在我盾上。
lines.en: The wind throws sand at my shield.
This stretch is very dry.
I go around a sharp stone.
I pause, then go on.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴短，摆起来也不快。
lines.en: My tail is short and swings slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿沙丘根走，避开开阔地。
lines.en: I walk along the dune base, avoiding open ground.
I look this way, then that.
I crouch and press my belly down.
My shield is not much, but it shields.
Sand got in my mouth.

lines.zh: 亚洲的小角龙，低头吃草。
lines.en: A small Asian ceratopsian, head down to graze.

lines.zh: 这片沙地，实在没什么可看。
lines.en: Nothing much to see on this sand.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看了看树顶的光。
lines.en: I look up at the light in the treetops.
My nostrils work.
The sun is harsh.

lines.zh: 我站在沙里，嘴慢慢嚼着。
lines.en: I stand in the sand, mouth chewing slowly.
There is a shadow in the distance.
My eyes half shut, my mouth still moving.

lines.zh: 我这小角龙，低头就是啃。
lines.en: A little ceratopsian like me just keeps grazing.
I do not like noise.
I tuck my head in.
You bent down to look at me.

lines.zh: 我这一段脖子，不太够用。
lines.en: This neck of mine does not reach far.

lines.zh: 我这副小角龙的身板，撑得住。
lines.en: This small ceratopsian frame holds up.
I back away, frill half covering my face.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，抬眼看你一下。
lines.en: I chew grass and glance up at you.
Do not trample my grass.
I made a nest on the dune.
You stare at me, and I stare back.
My shield is toward you.
I turn my head away and keep chewing.
You will not eat me, will you.
I am leaving.
Sand fills my neck frill.
That knocked my shield askew.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，四腿往下沉。
lines.en: I grunt, and my four legs sink.

lines.zh: 我退到灌木里，缩起脖子。
lines.en: I back into the shrubs, neck tucked.
It hurts, and I can hold my ground.

lines.zh: 我的腿有点软，沙丘太陡。
lines.en: My legs feel weak; the dune is steep.
There is red on the sand.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我把身子横过来。
lines.en: After the hit, I turn my body sideways.
I can still butt.
Try again.
Is that young leaf?
This smells like fermented fruit.
Keep that raised hand still.

lines.zh: 我踮起前腿，还是差一截。
lines.en: I rise on my forelegs, still short of it.

lines.zh: 这点太小，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: Too small even for a tooth gap.
I take a slow bite.

lines.zh: 我吃完这片，又看向你的手。
lines.en: I finish the leaf and look at your hand again.

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子，引我挪了两步。
lines.en: The leaves in your hand draw me two steps closer.

lines.zh: 这草叶带露水，嚼着很甜。
lines.en: These leaves are dewy and sweet to chew.
I pulled my head back in.
You bumped into my neck frill.
I was shoved aside whole.
My shield took some of it.
Short legs — the bump knocked me off balance.
I slid a stretch on the sand.

lines.zh: 你推我，我四腿撑住沙地。
lines.en: You push me, and my four legs brace in the sand.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边挤过，鳞片蹭到你。
lines.en: I squeeze past your leg, scales brushing you.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我晃了晃尾巴。
lines.en: You bump me, and my tail sways.

lines.zh: 你踩到原角龙的尾巴了。
lines.en: You stepped on the protoceratops' tail.
I hide behind the bush.
I lower my head and turn my shield to it.

lines.zh: 她的颈盾比我宽，靠了过来。
lines.en: Her frill is wider than mine as she comes close.
We gnaw the low bushes together.
Two shadows on the sand.
This patch will feed us both.
It lies down first.

lines.zh: 我卧在她身侧，慢慢嚼草。
lines.en: I lie beside her, slowly chewing grass.

lines.zh: 远处有影子，她先抬起了头。
lines.en: A shape in the distance; she raises her head first.
Neither of us moves.
At dawn we part.
There is a leaf on the ground.

lines.zh: 我低头叼起果子，抬头看你。
lines.en: I pick up the fruit and look up at you.
Not food.

lines.zh: 我叼起又放下，果子太硬。
lines.en: I pick it up and drop it; the fruit is too hard.

lines.zh: 我用前爪把那颗果子拨过来。
lines.en: I hook the fruit closer with a foreclaw.
It rolled off my snout.

lines.zh: 我护着的东西，你也敢碰？
lines.en: You'd touch what I'm guarding?
Did you drop it?
It rolled away; I did not go after it.
I dropped it.

lines.zh: 我的小颈盾，只护得住自己。
lines.en: My small frill can only guard myself.

lines.zh: 我抬起喙，闻到了陌生的味。
lines.en: I raise my beak and catch an unfamiliar scent.
I swing my shield around.
I pull my head back behind my frill.
I will not run.

lines.zh: 我停下嚼草，朝你的方向看。
lines.en: I stop chewing and look your way.
Something has entered my sand hollow.
I stand my ground.
I lower my frill and face you squarely.

lines.zh: 我四蹄蹬地，颈盾对准你。
lines.en: I plant all four feet, frill aimed at you.

lines.zh: 沙上有脚步声，我停住嚼草。
lines.en: Footsteps on the sand; I stop chewing.

lines.zh: 沙地上有影子靠近我的窝。
lines.en: A shadow creeps toward my nest on the sand.

lines.zh: 我把喙埋低，颈盾朝前顶。
lines.en: I lower my beak and angle my frill forward.

lines.zh: 我发出低哼，颈盾微微抬起。
lines.en: I grunt low, lifting my frill a little.
I back off, step by step.

lines.zh: 它每近一步，我的喙就低一分。
lines.en: Each step it takes, my beak dips lower.
My neck frill is solid bone.
No road left.
I raise my shield.
It has gone around my flank.
A bone frill rings my neck.
My legs shake, but I stand.

lines.zh: 我把喙压低，正对它的膝盖。
lines.en: I lower my beak level with its knee.
Then it's a charge. I won't dodge.
I shift around it.
My short tail sweeps the sand.
It is far taller than I.
Butting is all I have.

lines.zh: 它低头了，我往前迈一步。
lines.en: It lowers its head; I take one step in.
My beak cracks against its shin.
My shield hits it.
Not heavy, but solid.

lines.zh: 我一头顶在它的肋骨上。
lines.en: I drive my head into its ribs.
Frill down, I butt again.
My beak clamped on.
I cannot throw it off.

lines.zh: 我一顶，它退开，我收回头。
lines.en: One butt, it backs off, and I pull my head back.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我鼻孔喷着白气。
lines.en: After the hit, steam puffs from my nostrils.
That went well.

lines.zh: 我横过身子，肩盾撞过去。
lines.en: I swing my body around and ram with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我顶得太用力，自己晃了一下。
lines.en: I butt too hard and stagger myself.
It did not give ground.
Once more.
I rise from the sand.

lines.zh: 我踩上干沙，脚趾陷进去一点。
lines.en: I step onto dry sand, toes sinking slightly.
Plenty of low bushes.

lines.zh: 我颈后那块盾，替我挡着风。
lines.en: The shield behind my neck blocks the wind.
The wind is strong.
A small Cretaceous neck frill.
There are none of my kind here.
My shield is a little worn.
There are stones far off.

lines.zh: 我低着头，从灌木里踱出来。
lines.en: Head low, I pace out of the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘后走出，抬头看日头。
lines.en: I walk from behind the dune and look up at the sun.
The light here is very white.
I smell water.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙脊走，影子拖在身后。
lines.en: I walk the sand ridge, shadow trailing behind me.

lines.zh: 沙上有三道爪印，不是我的。
lines.en: Three claw marks in the sand, not mine.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，慢慢走出来。
lines.en: I step out slowly over fallen leaves.
There is wind here.
I bury half of myself.
The heat makes my shield brittle.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的肚子先落地。
lines.en: I fall and land on my belly.
I am young; my frill has not spread.
The blast rolls me over the sand.
Something is stuck in my shield.
My head grew heavy and will not lift.
Too little grass here.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我颈盾上，四腿僵直。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my frill, and my legs lock.
An egg is pressed under me.
